title: Multi Disk Sludge Dewatering Screw Press Sludge Dewatering Screw
summary: A multi-disk screw press for solid-liquid separation that dewaters municipal and industrial sludge using the extrusion force created by the changing screw diameter and pitch. It suits a wide concentration range and offers self-cleaning operation with low energy and water consumption.
bullets: Handles low to high concentration sludge

specs.label: Capacity (YMDL101)
specs.value: 6-12 kg/h dry solids; 3 m³/h at 2000 mg/L

specs.label: Capacity (YMDL403A)
specs.value: 180-1000 kg/h dry solids; 72 m³/h at 2000 mg/L
